installation.script: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt update && apt install -y git curl ca-certificates python3 make g++ && mkdir -p /mnt/server && cd /mnt/server && git clone -b "${GIT_BRANCH:-main}" "${GIT_REPO:-https://github.com/shyskyfox/LinyaShare.git}" . && npm install

startup.script: cd /home/container || exit 1 && if [ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" = "true" ]; then git config --global user.email "pterodactyl@localhost" && git config --global user.name "Pterodactyl Panel" && git fetch origin && TARGET_BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-main}" && CURRENT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) && if [ "$CURRENT_BRANCH" != "$TARGET_BRANCH" ]; then git checkout "$TARGET_BRANCH"; fi && git pull origin "$TARGET_BRANCH" && if git diff --name-only HEAD~1 | grep -q "package.json"; then npm install; fi; fi && export PORT="${SERVER_PORT}" && export NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL="${NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL:-http://localhost:$PORT}" && export NEXTAUTH_URL="${NEXTAUTH_URL:-$NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}" && export AUTH_TRUST_HOST="${AUTH_TRUST_HOST:-true}" && export DATABASE_URL="file:/home/container/prisma/linyashare.db" && npm run build && mkdir -p .next/standalone/.next/static && cp -rf .next/static/* .next/standalone/.next/static/ 2>/dev/null || true && [ -d public ] && cp -rf public/* .next/standalone/public/ 2>/dev/null || true && npm run setup && cd .next/standalone && node server.js

variables.name: GitHub Repository
variables.description: URL to the LinyaShare GitHub repository.

variables.name: Auto-Update
variables.description: If 'true', pulls the latest code from GitHub on every server restart.

variables.name: NextAuth Secret
variables.description: A random secret key for session encryption.

variables.name: Public App URL
variables.description: The public URL of your instance (e.g., https://share.example.com).

variables.name: NextAuth URL
variables.description: Callback URL for Auth. Defaults to Public App URL if left empty.

variables.name: Auth Trust Host
variables.description: Set to 'true' to allow the server to trust the incoming host header.
